    • setSymbolType

      public void setSymbolType(SymbolType symbolType)
      Set the symbol type.

      A null argument falls back to SymbolType.NOSYMBOL, not this object's own default (SymbolType.SQUARE, used only for a freshly-constructed Styled) — so passing null here is not equivalent to never having set a symbol type.

      Specified by:
      setSymbolType in interface IStyled
      Parameters:
      symbolType - the new symbol type, or null to select SymbolType.NOSYMBOL
